description: Contextual medium-to-high density residential district. Quality Housing mandatory. Higher FAR than R6A. Typically produces 7-10 story buildings.

bulk.far_note: UAP standard. Community facility FAR per ZR §24-11.

height_setback.street_wall_setback_wide_st: 10 ft depth above max base height
height_setback.street_wall_setback_narrow_st: 15 ft depth above max base height
height_setback.street_wall_location: No closer to street line than buildings within 150 ft on same block
height_setback.notes: Per ZR §23-432 table (R7A, R7-11, R7-21 rows). Standard: min base 40, max base 75, max height 85 ft. Qualifying affordable/senior: max base 85, max height 115 ft.

side.requirement: Per §23-335: none required for Quality Housing contextual districts

rear.through_lot_alternative: Rear yard equivalent per §23-343 on through lots ≥180 ft

permitted_uses.parking: Parking not permitted in front yard

dob_filing_notes: Quality Housing Program certification required in DOB NOW
R7A allows higher FAR than R6A — confirm district designation on zoning map
If UAP affordable housing: FAR increases to 5.01 — requires MIH or UAP documentation
BSA special permit needed for any height/setback modifications
